svg.aria-label: Anatomy of one LoRa APRS frame at SF12
svg.title: Anatomy of one LoRa APRS frame at SF12
svg.text: One LoRa APRS frame from YB1SDL-9, as it goes on air (SF12, 125 kHz, CR 4/5)
frequency of the signal, symbol by symbol (payload values are the real ones decoded from the recording)
What the 85 payload bytes contain (widths not to scale)
APRS information field: position, symbol, course/speed, comment, altitude (60 bytes)
The radio chip adds a 2-byte CRC-16 after these 85 bytes; it is the only error check LoRa APRS has.
